rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_moderation.moderation_case and moderation_event tables, then drops both tables and the northstar_moderation schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. The schema holds only moderation case metadata and an append-only lifecycle trail, so no reportable content (annotation/comment) is affected by a rollback.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_moderation schema with the moderation_case and moderation_event tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped moderation table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC
